metadata.title: तंदूरी मुर्गा आदिवासी स्टाइल में कैसे पकाएं  | How Tribals Cook Desi Murga in Mud
metadata.description:
Join Shyam Sunder as he journeys into a remote tribal village in the lush forests of Jharkhand, where Adivasi families still preserve their age-old style of cooking. In this rare exploration, he witnesses how traditional Adivasi kitchens—rooted in nature, simplicity, and ancestral wisdom—continue to thrive far from the modern world.
From gathering ingredients in the jungle to cooking over wood-fired chulhas, Shyam uncovers culinary practices that are rapidly disappearing. This immersive visit not only showcases unique tribal dishes but also celebrates a vibrant culture that keeps its heritage alive through food.
